welcome: [AR] Welcome, mortal. Athena's voice reaches you across the ages. Today, you begin the Twelve Labors.

move.title: الحركة
move.prompt: [AR] Drag the joystick (bottom-left) to move. Try it now.

look.title: الكاميرا
look.prompt: [AR] Swipe anywhere else to look around the world.
look.success: [AR] The world turns beneath your gaze.

attack.title: الهجوم
attack.prompt: [AR] Tap the sword button (bottom-right) to strike. Strike the training post.
attack.success: [AR] Steel rings true. The post is split.

dodge.title: التفادي
dodge.prompt: [AR] Swipe down on the dodge button to roll away from danger.
dodge.success: [AR] You moved like water. The blow missed.

ability.title: القدرات
ability.prompt: [AR] Long-press the ability button to charge your companion's power. Release to unleash it.
ability.success: [AR] Athena's Wisdom reveals a hint in the world.

inventory.title: الحقيبة
inventory.prompt: [AR] Tap the satchel icon to open your inventory. Select an item to inspect it.

interact.title: التفاعل
interact.prompt: [AR] Approach a glowing object and tap the hand icon to interact.
interact.success: [AR] Lifted. The object responds to your touch.

save.title: الحفظ
save.prompt: [AR] Step on the blue save rune to record your journey. You can also save from the pause menu.

puzzle_intro.title: الألغاز
puzzle_intro.prompt: [AR] Ahead lies a puzzle room. Read the runes, experiment, and observe. Combat alone will not save you here.

combat_intro.title: القتال
combat_intro.prompt: [AR] An enemy approaches. Watch for the wind-up — strike between their blows. Blocking reduces damage.

boss_intro.title: معركة الزعيم
boss_intro.prompt: [AR] A great foe awaits. Look for the puzzle-weakness phase — every boss has one. Athena's Wisdom can reveal it once per level.
boss_intro.success: [AR] The boss falls. Take its relic.

relic.title: الآثار
relic.prompt: [AR] A relic grants permanent bonuses. Equip it from the Hub Town's Relic Wall.

companion.title: الرفقاء
companion.prompt: [AR] A companion has joined your party. Switch active companions at the Hub Town. Your party holds up to three.

hub.title: بلدة المحور
hub.prompt: [AR] This is your sanctuary: the Temple, Shop, Relic Wall, and World Map. Depart when you are ready for the next Labor.

overworld.title: العالم الخارجي
overworld.prompt: [AR] Walk the overworld to find puzzle markers and the boss gate. Hidden chests hold gold and lore.

death.title: الهزيمة
death.prompt: [AR] You fell — but the gods are not finished with you. Rise at the last save rune.
death.success: [AR] Resurrected. Try again, wiser this time.

hint.athena: [AR] Athena offers a hint. Use it once per level — your Wisdom is not infinite.
hint.no_hint: [AR] No hint available here. Trust your instincts.

objective.title: الهدف
objective.prompt: [AR] Your current objective appears at the top of the screen. Tap it to pin a quest marker on the map.

settings.title: الإعدادات
settings.prompt: [AR] Open the pause menu anytime to adjust audio, controls, and accessibility options.

complete.title: اكتمال الشرح
complete.prompt: [AR] You've learned the basics. The Twelve Labors await — go forth, hero.
complete.success: [AR] The tutorial ends. The myth begins.
